title: Q-RES-perez-lopez-1974-P2: Not knowing that an essential variable is disturbed (measured 0.717, target >= 0.95)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: perez-lopez-1974 finding P2 is not-met (measured 0.717)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe perez-lopez-1974:P2
**Prediction:** essential_measured_share >= 0.95 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** editing the study, its target or the paper to match the code; the measurement is changed only by changing the mechanism
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation research --probe perez-lopez-1974:P2`
**Status:** open

Concern: Not knowing that an essential variable is disturbed. The study: Nature has given organisms the mechanisms that keep essential variables in limits; it has not given them to organizations, so they must be built in on purpose. "An organism may die because it does not have a 'program' to cope with disturbances in the value of its essential variables. An organization may die because it does not know that its essential variables are disturbed."

Mechanisms that should answer it: ULTRASTABILITY-1 (foundation/ultrastability.py); REDTEAM-1 (foundation/redteam.py).

Metric: share of essential variables (platform and tenant) whose latest reading in the last 7 days has a value (ops/ultrastability.jsonl), target >= 0.95. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
